messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Replace old strings if needed. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the whole body, headstock, neck, fretboard, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Look at similar models, age, and condition. | Knowing the going rate helps you price competitively and avoid underselling. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, any upgrades, and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music stores or pawn shops** – quick cash, but usually lower offers.
• **Specialty forums** – e.g., Acoustic Guitar Forum, Gearslutz. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Realistic Price** | Start slightly above your target price to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point keeps you from selling too low. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup** – no shipping costs, safer for both parties.
• **Shipping** – use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with insurance and tracking. | Shipping adds cost and risk; local pickup is simpler for most sellers. | | **8. Prepare for Negotiation** | Be ready to answer questions about playability, maintenance history, and any issues. | Prompt, honest answers keep negotiations smooth and prevent last‑minute cancellations. | | **9. Secure Payment** | • **Cash** – safest for local sales.
• **PayPal / Venmo** – secure online payment.
• **Escrow services** – for high‑value items. | Protect yourself from fraud and ensure you receive funds before handing over the guitar. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Sign a simple bill of sale (include serial number, price, date, and both parties’ signatures). | Provides legal proof of transfer and protects both parties. | | **11. Follow Up** | Ask the buyer for feedback (if using an online platform) and thank them. | Positive reviews boost future sales and build your reputation as a trustworthy seller. | ### Quick Tips - **Avoid “too good to be true” offers** – they’re often scams. - **Use a protective case** when shipping; consider a hard shell case for extra safety. - **Keep receipts** for any recent repairs or upgrades; they add value. - **Be patient** – sometimes it takes a week or two to find the right buyer. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2005 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2005 - Serial: 12345678 - Condition: Gently used, no scratches or dents. New strings installed. - Features: Solid spruce top, nato/okume back & sides, 25.5" scale. - Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 2010 Martin D-28. - Included: Original case, strap, and a set of replacement strings. Price: $350 (negotiable) Photos: [Attach 5–6 high‑resolution images] Contact: [Your email] or direct message on Reverb. ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your chosen platform. Good luck with your sale! If you need help tuning the guitar before you list it, let me know—I can run the tuning function for you.
message.reasoning: User asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can give steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention local music stores, pawn shops. Provide tips for negotiation. Also mention warranties, return policy. Provide contact info for listing. No function call needed.
